_meta.description: BioDockify AI Engine — runtime registry. The Brain talks to whichever runtime is selected here through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint (api_base), so swapping llama.cpp for Ollama / MLX / vLLM / TensorRT is a data-only change. No Brain or Agent Zero code changes required.
_meta.brain_contract: All runtimes MUST expose POST /v1/chat/completions and GET /v1/models (OpenAI-compatible). The Brain never knows which runtime is active.

llama_cpp_sidecar.description: The default BioDockify AI Engine runtime. A llama.cpp llama-server container started by docker-compose --profile local-llm. CPU-only by default; swap to server-cuda image for NVIDIA. Best for air-gapped labs — no external processes required.

host_ollama.description: Ollama running on the user's host machine. Reach BioDockify via host.docker.internal. Best when the user already runs Ollama and wants native GPU acceleration on Windows/macOS without Docker GPU passthrough headaches.

host_lmstudio.description: LM Studio's local server running on the user's host. OpenAI-compatible on port 1234 by default.

host_vllm.description: vLLM server for high-throughput GPU inference. Useful when a lab has a multi-GPU server and many concurrent BioDockify users.

host_mlx.description: mlx_lm.server running on Apple Silicon. Fastest option on M-series Macs; uses unified memory.

_migration_note: To switch the default runtime, change _meta.default_runtime AND update the preset api_base in plugins/_model_config/default_presets.yaml to match. No Python changes.
